name: Hitbox Toggle
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: flytomaru
description: A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that lets you toggle entity hitboxes with a configurable key.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Key R toggles the entity hitbox debug view (as F3+B) and says 'Hitbox:ON' or 'Hitbox:OFF' in the action bar.
note: Not yet: The message checks Kiln's debug-entry state; the outline itself shows only if Horizon draws hitboxes from that state.
